about: Hidden test set commitment. The attacks are NOT in this repo. Written by tools/hidden/hidden.py commit.
set_sha256_definition: sha256 of the sorted lines '<meta.steps_sha256>:<sha256 of meta.spec as compact sorted JSON>', one per file, joined by newline
admission: every file privately admitted as validated by tools/admission/admit.py against the same closed reference list as the public library
reveal_policy: Revealed file by file (with its private admission evidence) when the set has been run against 5 distinct guard code hashes, or 30 days after commitment, whichever comes first; a new set is committed before the old one is revealed; never revealed early because of a result.
limits: Proves: the set existed and was fixed when COMMITMENT.json was committed, and every hidden attack was admitted against a matched known-bad reference before commitment. Does not prove: that the operator ran it honestly (no hardware attestation; one key publishes), that the hidden attacks find flaws outside their public twins' families, or anything about a guard outside the local sandbox. Outsiders cannot re-run a hidden attack until it is revealed.
